task.description: Change validator exit-code semantics so warnings-only canary trip exits 0; criticals exit non-zero (1); invocation/IO errors keep exit 2
task.changes: Line 430: return 2 -> return 0 in the warnings-only branch of main(). Lines 11-13: docstring exit-code legend updated to match new contract (0=no critical errors with warnings allowed; 1=critical issues; 2=invocation/IO error).
task.rationale: Root cause B1: prior author chose exit 2 for warnings-only as a tri-state signal, which violated AC2 literal text and standard CLI severity-alignment convention (eslint/mypy/ruff: warnings-only -> 0). BA confirmed zero shell callers and the only Python caller (sync-agent-data.py) uses importlib and never inspects exit code, so blast radius is nil.

task.description: Extend scripts/lib/json_io.py with OwnershipError + UniversalImageDeny exceptions, _reject_unauthorized_ownership rejector, and _reject_universal_image_url rejector; wire both into save_agent_json BEFORE _reject_unsafe_image_payloads.
task.rationale: QA objection 2: Python-internal write surface (sync-agent-data.py, strip-image-url-fields.py) is invisible to a Bash PreToolUse hook. Move enforcement to the persistence layer so any write through save_agent_json fires the ownership + image_url rejectors regardless of caller (Python script, save.py, future scripts). Reads owned_files regex list from .claude/agents/<agent_name>.md frontmatter — same source as the Bash hook so both layers agree.

task.description: Register pretool-block-production-files.sh in .claude/settings.json PreToolUse with matcher 'Write|Edit|Bash'.
task.changes: Added new entry under hooks.PreToolUse with matcher 'Write|Edit|Bash' and stdin_json: true.
task.rationale: QA objection 1: BA iter 1's wiring assumption was wrong — no entry existed at all (0 grep hits in project + global settings.json). The W6 hook from the parent cycle was a file on disk that NEVER fired at runtime. This registration is the prerequisite for ANY hook-based enforcement to be live.

task.description: Refactor scripts/sync-agent-data.py:_save_json to route through json_io.save_agent_json instead of direct open(); json.dump().
task.changes: Replaced direct write at lines 181-183 with save_agent_json(path, agent_name=path.stem, data=data, validate=False, create_backup=False, allow_high_severity=True). Added 'from lib.json_io import save_agent_json' at module top.
task.rationale: Closes the bypass surface at the source. Without this refactor, the json_io ownership rejector exists but sync-agent-data never invokes it.

task.description: Refactor scripts/strip-image-url-fields.py:process_file to route through json_io.save_agent_json when image_url fields are stripped.
task.changes: Replaced direct write at lines 36-37 with save_agent_json(path, agent_name=path.stem, data=inner_data, validate=False, create_backup=False, allow_high_severity=True). Added 'from lib.json_io import save_agent_json' at module top. Inner data extracted from envelope when present (data.get('data', data)).
task.rationale: Same bypass-closure rationale as sync-agent-data.py. After stripping image_url fields the universal image_url deny is a no-op (payload is image_url-free); ownership still applies.

task.description: Extend .claude/hooks/pretool-block-production-files.sh with a Bash branch that intercepts (a) python scripts/save.py invocations with --input image_url payloads, (b) python scripts/save.py invocations targeting unauthorized agent paths, (c) direct shell redirect/tee/cp/mv to data/<trip>/<file>.json. SAME hook file, no separate hook stack (architect concern_6).
task.changes: Replaced 'case $TOOL_NAME in Write|Edit) ;; *) exit 0' with three-arm dispatch: Write|Edit (existing behavior), Bash (new — runs Python regex detection of save.py + direct-data-write patterns and applies image_url + ownership checks), * (exit 0). Existing PYHOOK_EOF heredoc unchanged.
task.rationale: QA objection on AC9 surface: data agents canonical write path is Bash via save.py; Write|Edit-only dispatch missed the entire AC9 control. Bash branch closes the secondary defense (json_io persistence layer is primary).

task.description: Create scripts/tests/test_json_io_ownership.py with 4 sub-tests verifying authorized write succeeds, cross-agent write raises OwnershipError, image_url payload raises UniversalImageDeny/StockImageRejected, and unknown-agent write raises OwnershipError.
task.rationale: AC-OWNERSHIP recipe: this is the verbatim test the AC mandates. Mirrors the existing test_merge_agent_slots.py pattern (standalone harness + pytest-compatible).

task.description: Create scripts/tests/test_hook_bash_branch.sh with 8 sub-cases proving the Bash branch isolation behavior (direct redirect blocks, save.py mention-only allows, save.py with clean payload allows, save.py with image_url blocks, tee/cp into data block, non-data Bash allows).
task.rationale: AC2 reformulated recipe: Bash-detection sub-case in isolation. Eight envelopes piped to the hook directly, recording exit code + stderr against expected. All 8 PASS.

task.description: Remove .claude/.hook-refactor-allow from working tree AND git index
task.rationale: Sentinel was committed accidentally in prior session. Per pretool-claude-config-guard.py line 75-77, sentinel presence at `_project_dir()/.claude/.hook-refactor-allow` causes the hook to exit 0 (allow), bypassing the protection on .claude/hooks/ and .claude/commands/. Removing the sentinel re-engages the guard.

task.changes: Added 3 lines after the existing `.claude/workflow-current.json` block: blank line, comment, and the pattern itself.
task.rationale: Prevents accidental re-commit of the sentinel. Pattern matches the exact path so users can still create the sentinel locally for opt-in refactor sessions; only the index commit is blocked.
